daily.today_energy: The Moon in Aries is pushing you toward action, but Saturn retrograde keeps things introspective. Neptune (your ruler) is quietly working behind the scenes, so trust your gut more than usual today.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is bringing warmth to your connections. If you're coupled up, conversations flow easier. Single? Someone might be noticing your vibe. Keep it real and don't overthink the small stuff.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is amplifying ambition everywhere, but the Sun squaring these planets means you might feel pulled in different directions. Focus on one priority instead of spreading yourself thin.
daily.health: That Aries Moon energy wants you moving, but don't burn out. Balance intensity with rest. Your intuition is sharp today—if something feels off, listen to it. Stay hydrated and take breaks.

weekly.overview: This week hits different as the Moon glides from your sign into Taurus, then Gemini, peaking at the Full Moon. The Sun square Mars energy early week brings friction—things feel pushy—but Venus sextile Jupiter midweek softens the vibe considerably. Best Day: Wednesday. Watch-Out Day: Monday. Big shift: Sun enters Sagittarius Friday, sparking fresh adventure.
weekly.love: Early week tension from Sun square Mars might have you feeling defensive or withdrawn, but don't let it. Midweek blooms beautifully—Venus sextile Jupiter makes you magnetic and genuinely warm. Someone's noticing. By the weekend, the Full Moon illuminates what you actually want, cutting through confusion. Lean into honesty.
weekly.career: Monday brings frustration (Sun square Mars collision), so avoid major decisions or confrontations then. Midweek flips the script—your ideas land better, collaborations spark. The Full Moon Friday brings clarity on a project or goal you've been sitting with. Use this momentum to pitch something or pivot your approach.
weekly.health: The Full Moon energy can feel intense and emotional, so prioritize grounding practices midweek. Mars conjunction Jupiter says move your body—your confidence and endurance are genuinely elevated right now. Don't overthink it; just show up and feel the difference.
